connections.desktopUnavailable: The desktop connection is unavailable. Retry when the app is ready.

chatgpt.notice: LearnHarness stores your ChatGPT account details and credentials in an unencrypted local file on this device. When this connection is used, relevant conversation context, learning material, and tool results are sent directly to OpenAI. ChatGPT plan limits apply; any additional credits are authorized and managed in ChatGPT, not LearnHarness.
chatgpt.backgroundHint: Background work counts toward your ChatGPT plan usage.
chatgpt.backgroundLabel: Allow background use for all ChatGPT accounts
chatgpt.revocationWarning: Account disconnected locally. Remote revocation could not be confirmed.
chatgpt.disconnectBody: This removes the saved account and its credentials from this device.
chatgpt.controlError: The ChatGPT connection could not be changed. Try again.
chatgpt.desktopOnly: ChatGPT sign-in is available only in the desktop app. API-key connections remain available here.

subscriptions.policyNotice: Pi's native Copilot sign-in may enable additional models whose policy is not yet configured. Models explicitly disabled by policy are not enabled. Organization restrictions still apply.
subscriptions.backgroundHint: Allow LearnHarness helper agents and automatic follow-ups to use this connection.
subscriptions.notice: Your prompts, tool results, and relevant session context are sent to {{label}} to run the work you select. Credentials are stored locally in an owner-only plaintext file. Provider terms, data-use policies, and plan limits apply. This connection never falls back to an API key.
subscriptions.disconnectBody: Disconnect {{label}} from LearnHarness? This stops work using this connection and removes its saved credentials from this device. It does not cancel your subscription or revoke access at the provider. Saved model choices will remain unavailable until you reconnect or change them.
subscriptions.controlError: The connection could not be changed. Try again.
subscriptions.signInFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Try connecting again.
subscriptions.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Try again.
subscriptions.desktopRequired: Subscription sign-in requires the desktop app's private server connection. API-key connections remain available here.

install.intro: Recognize speech on your computer with Standard ASR — no key, and audio never leaves the device. The first install downloads Python packages and the model files (about a gigabyte).
install.noUv: Local dictation needs uv, which the desktop app includes. In a browser session, install uv first (docs.astral.sh/uv).
